Publications

I lead the Behavioral Neuroendocrinology Lab, which investigates the biological systems that link psychological and social factors to health, with a focus on neuroendocrine systems and the autonomic nervous system. Below is a list of my publications, preprints and research materials are linked where available; email me if anything is behind a paywall.
